summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Volatility Shares 2x Sui ETF (SUIL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sui, short usd currency. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide 2x the daily price movements of Sui (SUI). The funds primary investment is cash-settled futures contracts SUIL was launched on May 15, 2026 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
